name: Approval card
purpose: Summarize a completed piece of work and ask for a decision on it.
description: A review surface with the summary, the affected detail, and explicit approve or decline actions.

hint.description: Small print under the request. Empty by default.

guidance.summary: Summarizes one finished piece of work and asks a person to approve it or send it back.
useWhen: An agent or a colleague produced something reviewable, and one person decides on it.
The decision is about one item, with its summary in view.

avoidWhen.text: Many items wait for decisions: list them as rows with one action each.
An agent asks to run a consequential operation.
Values must be checked against a source first.

states.label: Pending
states.description: The summary and both decisions are available.

states.label: Approved
states.description: The host re-renders with the outcome after the person approved.

states.label: Declined
states.description: The host re-renders with the outcome after the person sent it back.

dos.title: One decision per screen part
dos.description: Several cards each asking to approve leave no order.

dos.title: Labels that name the outcome
dos.description: Approve plan, Send back: people know what follows.

donts.title: A grid of approval cards
donts.description: Equal boxes hide which decision is most urgent.

donts.title: Approving without the evidence
donts.description: The summary must hold what the decision depends on.

content: The title names the work; the summary says what changes if it is approved.

notes: A group named by its title; each decision is a button.
A decision is a request; the host confirms before anything runs.

composition.defaultVisible: Title, summary, detail, and both decisions.
composition.density: One per screen part; a queue of approvals is a table.

redundantWith.reason: Two decisions about the same work.
A banner announcing the approval the card already asks for.

mistakes: Three approval cards side by side.
An approval card inside a card or panel.
